methods.b_mcnemar_sim: 5000 Monte Carlo draws of baseline hit count k0~Binom(n_pos,tpr0); m~Binom(k0,delta) hits lost; exact McNemar p=2*0.5^m (c=0); power=P(p<.05)
methods.c_bootstrap_shift: 200 outer sims x 200 inner bootstraps (coarse grid), harmful scores shifted toward the benign mean by f*gap, detection = 95% CI of the bootstrap AUROC-diff excluding 0
